```{r}
# set up Bioconductor once 
install.packages("BiocManager")
BiocManager::install("DESeq2")

# ---- libraries ----
library(DESeq2)
library(tidyverse)
```


```{r}
# define paths 
counts_path <- "work/06_counts/alt_counts_edit.csv"
meta_path   <- "work/06_counts/sample_table_edit.csv"

# ---- load data ----
cts_df <- read.csv(counts_path, check.names = FALSE)
meta_df <- read.csv(meta_path, check.names = FALSE)
```


```{r}
# counts: feature column -> rownames, rest are sample columns
cts <- cts_df %>%
  column_to_rownames("feature") %>%
  as.matrix()

# metadata: sample column -> rownames
meta <- meta_df %>%
  column_to_rownames("sample")

# ensure the columns of counts match the rows of metadata
cts <- cts[, rownames(meta), drop=FALSE]

# factors
meta$condition <- factor(meta$condition, levels = c("R","X"))
meta$replicate <- factor(meta$replicate)
```


```{r}
# ---- helper: run DESeq2 per virus ----
run_deseq_onevirus <- function(virus_name, cts, meta, out_prefix) {
  m <- meta[meta$virus == virus_name, , drop=FALSE]
  c <- cts[, rownames(m), drop=FALSE]

  # keep only features that have any counts in this virus subset
  keep_feat <- rowSums(c) > 0
  c <- c[keep_feat, , drop=FALSE]

  # DESeq2 dataset
  # replicate as blocking factor: increases power if rep1/rep2/rep3 have baseline shifts
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = round(c),
    colData   = m,
    design    = ~ replicate + condition
  )

  # optional: remove ultra-low features
  dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds)) >= 10, ]

  dds <- DESeq(dds)

  res <- results(dds, contrast = c("condition","X","R"))
  res_df <- as.data.frame(res) %>%
    rownames_to_column("feature") %>%
    separate(feature, into=c("pos","change"), sep="_") %>%
    mutate(
      pos = as.integer(pos),
      neglog10padj = -log10(padj),
      neglog10padj = ifelse(is.finite(neglog10padj), neglog10padj, NA_real_),
      neglog10padj_cap = pmin(neglog10padj, 10)  # cap for plot readability
    )

  # write table
  write.table(
    res_df,
    paste0(out_prefix, "_DESeq2_results.tsv"),
    sep="\t", quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE
  )

  # bubble plot (Fig3B-like)
  p <- ggplot(res_df, aes(x = pos, y = log2FoldChange)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_point(aes(size = neglog10padj_cap, shape = change), alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "-log10(padj) (capped)") +
    labs(
      title = paste0(virus_name, ": X vs R"),
      x = "Position (reference coordinate)",
      y = "log2FoldChange (X/R)"
    ) +
    theme_classic()

  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(out_prefix, "_bubbleplot.pdf"),
    plot = p, width = 12, height = 4
  )

  return(res_df)
}
```


```{r}
# ---- run both viruses ----
zikv_res <- run_deseq_onevirus("ZIKV", cts, meta, out_prefix="ZIKV")
denv_res <- run_deseq_onevirus("DENV", cts, meta, out_prefix="DENV")

# quick sanity summaries
cat("ZIKV rows:", nrow(zikv_res), "\n")
cat("DENV rows:", nrow(denv_res), "\n")
```

```{r}
# check P values 
sum(!is.na(zikv_res$padj) & zikv_res$padj < 0.05)
sum(!is.na(denv_res$padj) & denv_res$padj < 0.05)
```

```{r}
run_onevirus <- function(virus_name, cts, meta, out_prefix,
                         pos_min, pos_max,
                         min_total_counts = 10) {

  m <- meta[meta$virus == virus_name, , drop = FALSE]
  c <- cts[, rownames(m), drop = FALSE]

  # --- IMPORTANT: restrict to the region BEFORE DESeq2 ---
  # features look like "45_A>G" or "45_A>T"
  feat_pos <- as.integer(sub("_.*$", "", rownames(c)))
  keep_region <- feat_pos >= pos_min & feat_pos <= pos_max
  c <- c[keep_region, , drop = FALSE]

  # drop ultra-low features
  keep <- rowSums(c) >= min_total_counts
  c <- c[keep, , drop = FALSE]

  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = round(c),
    colData   = m,
    design    = ~ replicate + condition
  )

  dds <- DESeq(dds)
  res <- results(dds, contrast = c("condition", "X", "R"))

  # --- build a clean results table with a guaranteed 'feature' column ---
  res_df <- as.data.frame(res)
  res_df$feature <- rownames(res_df)

  res_df <- res_df %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    tidyr::separate(feature, into = c("pos", "change"), sep = "_", remove = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      pos = as.integer(pos),
      neglog10padj = -log10(padj),
      neglog10padj = ifelse(is.finite(neglog10padj), neglog10padj, NA_real_),
      neglog10padj_cap = pmin(neglog10padj, 10)
    ) %>%
    # keep only real columns (prevents the NA-name mess)
    dplyr::select(feature, pos, change, baseMean, log2FoldChange, lfcSE, stat, pvalue, padj,
                  neglog10padj, neglog10padj_cap)

  readr::write_tsv(res_df, paste0("work/06_counts/", out_prefix, "_DESeq2_results.tsv"))

  p <- ggplot(res_df, aes(x = pos, y = log2FoldChange)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_point(aes(size = neglog10padj_cap, shape = change), alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "-log10(padj)\n(capped at 10)") +
    labs(
      title = paste0(virus_name, ": X vs R (restricted region)"),
      x = "Position (reference coordinate)",
      y = "log2FoldChange (X/R)"
    ) +
    theme_classic()

  ggsave(paste0("work/06_counts/", out_prefix, "_bubbleplot.pdf"), p, width = 12, height = 4)

  return(res_df)
}
```

```{r}
library(DESeq2)
library(tidyverse)

cts_df  <- read.csv("work/06_counts/alt_counts_edit.csv", check.names = FALSE)
meta_df <- read.csv("work/06_counts/sample_table_edit.csv", check.names = FALSE)

cts <- cts_df %>% tibble::column_to_rownames("feature") %>% as.matrix()
meta <- meta_df %>% tibble::column_to_rownames("sample")

cts <- cts[, rownames(meta), drop = FALSE]

meta$condition <- factor(meta$condition, levels = c("R","X"))
meta$replicate <- factor(meta$replicate)
meta$virus     <- factor(meta$virus)

zikv_res <- run_onevirus("ZIKV", cts, meta, out_prefix="ZIKV",
                         pos_min=25, pos_max=107, min_total_counts=10)

denv_res <- run_onevirus("DENV", cts, meta, out_prefix="DENV",
                         pos_min=24, pos_max=104, min_total_counts=10)
```
```{r}
# annotate each mutation by structural context:
make_struct_df <- function(pos_min, pos_max, seq_rna, dotbracket) {
  stopifnot(nchar(seq_rna) == nchar(dotbracket))
  pos <- pos_min:pos_max
  tibble(
    pos = pos,
    ref_base_rna = strsplit(seq_rna, "")[[1]],
    struct = strsplit(dotbracket, "")[[1]],
    paired = struct %in% c("(", ")")
  )
}

denv_struct <- make_struct_df(
  pos_min = 24, pos_max = 104,
  seq_rna = "UAAAAGAAGUCAGGCCAUCAUAAAUGCCAUAGCUGGAGUAAACUAUGCAGCCUGUAGCUCCACCUGAGAAGGUGUAAAAAA",
  dotbracket = "..........(((((.........((.(((((.((.....))))))))))))))......(((((....)))))......."
)

zikv_struct <- make_struct_df(
  pos_min = 25, pos_max = 107,
  seq_rna = "AGCUCAUAGUCAGGCCGAGAACGCCAUGGCACGGAAGAAGCCAUGCUGCCUGUGAGCCCCUCAGAGGACACUGAGUCAAAAAA",
  dotbracket = "..........(((((((....)).((((((.........))))))..))))).......(((((......)))))........"
)

denv_annot <- denv_res %>% left_join(denv_struct, by="pos")
zikv_annot <- zikv_res %>% left_join(zikv_struct, by="pos")
```

```{r}
# compare effects in paired vs unpaired:

zikv_annot %>% group_by(paired) %>%
  summarize(median_lfc = median(log2FoldChange, na.rm=TRUE),
            n = n())

denv_annot %>% group_by(paired) %>%
  summarize(median_lfc = median(log2FoldChange, na.rm=TRUE),
            n = n())
```
```{r}
ggplot(zikv_annot, aes(x=pos, y=log2FoldChange)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept=0, linetype="dashed") +
  geom_point(aes(size=neglog10padj_cap, shape=change, alpha=paired)) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title="ZIKV: X vs R (paired vs unpaired)", x="pos", y="log2FC")
```


```{r}
# significance test (paired vs unpaired effect distributions)
# Wilcoxon because LFC distributions are not normal

wilcox.test(log2FoldChange ~ paired, data = zikv_annot)
wilcox.test(log2FoldChange ~ paired, data = denv_annot)
```
```{r}
# box plot - paired/unpaired summary plot 
ggplot(zikv_annot, aes(x = paired, y = log2FoldChange)) +

  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.2) +
  theme_classic() +

ggplot(denv_annot, aes(x = paired, y = log2FoldChange)) +
```

# Maintain vs disrupt Base Pairing
```{r}

# parse dot-bracket pairs
get_pair_map <- function(dotbracket, pos_start) {

  chars <- strsplit(dotbracket, "")[[1]]
  stack <- c()
  pair_map <- rep(NA_integer_, length(chars))

  for (i in seq_along(chars)) {
    if (chars[i] == "(") {
      stack <- c(stack, i)
    } else if (chars[i] == ")") {
      j <- tail(stack, 1)
      stack <- head(stack, -1)

      pair_map[i] <- j
      pair_map[j] <- i
    }
  }

  tibble(
    pos = pos_start:(pos_start + length(chars) - 1),
    partner_pos = ifelse(is.na(pair_map), NA,
                         pos_start + pair_map - 1)
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Allowed pairing rule
can_pair <- function(b1, b2) {
  pair <- paste0(b1, b2)
  pair %in% c("AU","UA","GC","CG","GU","UG")
}

annotate_pair_effect <- function(res_df, struct_df) {

  df <- dplyr::left_join(res_df, struct_df, by="pos") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(alt = sub(".*>", "", change))

  # partner base lookup
  partner_lookup <- struct_df %>%
    dplyr::select(pos, partner_ref = ref_base)

  df <- df %>%
    dplyr::left_join(partner_lookup, by = c("partner_pos" = "pos")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      paired = !is.na(partner_pos),
      pair_effect = dplyr::case_when(
        !paired ~ "unpaired",
        can_pair(alt, partner_ref) ~ "maintain",
        TRUE ~ "disrupt"
      )
    )

  df
}
```

```{r}
denv_pair_annot <- annotate_pair_effect(denv_res, denv_struct_df)
zikv_pair_annot <- annotate_pair_effect(zikv_res, zikv_struct_df)
```

```{r}
table(denv_pair_annot$pair_effect)
table(zikv_pair_annot$pair_effect)
```

```{r}
wilcox.test(log2FoldChange ~ pair_effect,
            data = dplyr::filter(denv_pair_annot, pair_effect != "unpaired"))

wilcox.test(log2FoldChange ~ pair_effect,
            data = dplyr::filter(zikv_pair_annot, pair_effect != "unpaired"))
```

```{r}
ggplot(dplyr::filter(zikv_pair_annot, pair_effect!="unpaired"),

ggplot(dplyr::filter(denv_pair_annot, pair_effect!="unpaired"),

  geom_hline(yintercept=0, linetype="dashed") +
```

```{r}
# classify the mutations: 
annotate_pair_effect <- function(res_df, struct_df) {

  df <- res_df %>%
    left_join(struct_df, by="pos") %>%
    rename(ref_rna = ref_base)

  # extract ALT nucleotide
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(alt = sub(".*>", "", change))

  # partner reference base
  df <- df %>%
    left_join(
      struct_df %>%
        select(pos, partner_ref = ref_base),
      by = c("partner_pos" = "pos")
    )

  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      paired = !is.na(partner_pos),
      pair_effect = case_when(
        !paired ~ "unpaired",
        can_pair(alt, partner_ref) ~ "maintain",
        TRUE ~ "disrupt"
      )
    )

  df
}
```


```{r}
denv_pair_annot <- annotate_pair_effect(denv_res, denv_struct_df)
zikv_pair_annot <- annotate_pair_effect(zikv_res, zikv_struct_df)
```

```{r}
            data = filter(denv_pair_annot, pair_effect != "unpaired"))
```
